character: A skiers-only ski area (no snowboards) at the head of Little Cottonwood Canyon in Utah's Wasatch Range, next to but separately ticketed from Snowbird. Lift service began in 1939; it has two base areas, Wildcat and Albion, linked by a transfer tow, with gentle terrain around Albion Basin and a large share of steep advanced terrain higher up.
learning: Reference note: first-timers normally start at the Albion base (Albion Basin), where the Sunnyside and Albion lifts serve the easiest groomed terrain; the Alta ski school (historically the Alf Engen Ski School) runs lessons. Skiing only — there are no snowboard lessons. Confirm current lift names, any carpet and 2026-27 beginner packages.
